audience: procurement and finance teams who buy through purchase orders in Precoro

useCases.title: Find purchase orders waiting for your approval
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase orders filtered by status or those waiting for your approval, with supplier, totals and payment status, and reads one with its items.

useCases.title: List unpaid supplier invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists supplier invoices and credit notes with due date, paid sum and payment status, and reads one with its matching to orders and payments.

useCases.title: Check how much of each budget is spent
useCases.text: The AI lists budgets with period, total sum and how much is used in requisitions, purchase orders, invoices and expenses.

useCases.title: Approve or reject documents waiting for you
useCases.text: The AI finds documents waiting for your approval, then approves one or rejects it with a comment. Approving can release spending and cannot be undone here.

useCases.title: Create a draft purchase requisition and submit it
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft requisition with location, currency, delivery date and items, and submits it for approval when you say so.

useCases.title: Look up suppliers or add a new one
useCases.text: The AI lists suppliers with payment conditions and contacts, reads one supplier, and creates a new supplier with a unique name.
